title: Port Omega Positioning Framework (S-11) — foundational docs gap
what_needed: The Omega Positioning Framework (S-11) — 12 files at omega_library/intake/inbox/omega-positioning-framework/ — has never been ported to the engine repo. This is the strategic foundation document that explains WHY the Omega Engine exists, its positioning vs Big AI, and the community promise. Every new contributor or agent needs this context.
why: The positioning framework is the project's soul. It's the document that answers 'why should I use this instead of ChatGPT/Ollama/LM Studio?' Without it ported, every new agent or contributor must reconstruct the positioning from context. This is the #1 documentation gap blocking community readiness.
producer_hint: Port to docs/strategy/positioning/. There are 12 files — start with the overview doc, then port the sub-docs. Estimated effort: 30 min.
